WITH filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS date) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS date)
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
),
warehouse_state AS (
    SELECT w_warehouse_sk, w_state
    FROM warehouse
)
SELECT w.w_state,
       fi.i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_date < CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)
                THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_date >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)
                THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) AS sales_after
FROM warehouse_state w
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN filtered_date fd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_items fi ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT cr_order_number, cr_item_sk, cr_refunded_cash
    FROM catalog_returns
) AS cr
       ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
      AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
GROUP BY w.w_state, fi.i_item_id
ORDER BY w.w_state, fi.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
